author: rapgoddes
body: I would like to appeal a Ban Evasion for my account- _JJpvp_. First of all, the account that got banned on this server was Owled, and that was a friends account to this server. My friend got banned on her account from my laptop because mods thought she was hacking and I was later banned for evading from this account. I had no idea what evading was and I didn't even know I was doing it. The problem is that my friend deleted her MC account and she doesn't play on this server anymore, so she wasn't able to appeal. I know I will not have a very high chance of getting appealed, but I really hope to come back to Avicus, because my sister and I used to play on this server a lot. I have been banned for about a month here. Also, I didn't know how to get back on the website, so I created a forum account. I think that is why is says "last seen 0 seconds ago." I hope can get appealed on here, because this was my favorite server. Thank you mods, JJ.

title: Appeal an Infraction

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

Minecraft accounts can't be deleted (https://www.avicus.net/Owled).
Your appeal is currently under review, you will get a reply soon.

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your infraction, I've decided to give you the benefit of the doubt and lift your punishment, please read to rules again to make sure you don't get punished again, my apologies for the inconvenience.

Best Regards,
Zeusy,
Avixus Senior Moderator
